::: {#exr-ce-logit-grad}

#### The gradient at the logits

Find the derivative of the [cross-entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-cross-entropy) loss $\loss = -\log \operatorname{softmax}(\vz)_y$,
where softmax is the [softmax function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/multiclass-logistic-regression.html#def-softmax),
with respect to each [logit](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-logits) $z_m$,
for $m = 1, \dots, C$,
where $C$ is the number of classes.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint
Start from [the log softmax theorem](feedforward-networks.qmd#thm-log-softmax).
:::
